record.title: Orlivka–Isaccea ferry admission suspended after attack, September 2026
record.endpoint_type: Staged restoration reported September 2–3; category and customs-operation timings qualified
record.direction: Crossing service suspended; no directional exemption identified
record.exceptions: Alternate routes recommended; no exemption at this ferry established.
record.imposing_authority: Ukrainian and Romanian border/customs authorities following reported attack
record.enforcement: Officials report suspension of ferry formalities pending safe operation; no inference about every attempted crossing.
record.relationship: Promoted R15-EU-L006; distinct from R15-EU-001 (September 2023) and R15-EU-002 (October 2023).
record.status_observation: Resumption is reported on September 2/3, 2026, with unresolved cross-source timing; not presumed still closed.
record.official_rationale: Romanian authority describes suspension after security events pending safe reopening; Ukrainian authority attributes attack to Russia.
record.uncertainty: Ukrainian Border Guard reported normal operation September 2. Romanian Coast Guard reported staged ferry resumption from September 2 19:00 and unrestricted vehicle movement by September 3 morning, whereas Romanian Customs specified September 3 09:00 after tests. These reports establish earlier staged operation but do not resolve each category, direction or formalities phase. Current September 2–3 restoration bounds must not be read as continuous complete closure.
